groups.defect: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined mainHostDestinationCalendar when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All six suggestions identify the same unguarded integration access; adding optional chaining at that access addresses them all.

groups.defect: A null evt.destinationCalendar silently drops collective team calendars, and collecting teamDestinationCalendars through mutation inside async map callbacks is also reported as fragile.
groups.rationale: Both report the same optional-push no-op when the organizer has no destination calendar. The first additionally reports fragile collection inside async callbacks, which must survive in the merged comment.

groups.defect: Google Calendar updateEvent and deleteEvent both search destination calendars using the falsy externalCalendarId that triggered the fallback, preventing the intended destination fallback.
groups.rationale: All five report the same faulty fallback repeated in updateEvent and deleteEvent. Both locations require the same correction.
